hosts.note: The Google API Discovery Service lists seven preferred APIs whose rootUrl is https://www.googleapis.com/: Calendar, Discovery, Drive, Groups Settings, Identity Toolkit, OAuth2 and Site Verification. Host matching cannot see the path, so a request here is attributed to Google without naming the API.

rootUrl of the Google Docs API in its Discovery Service document, and the service endpoint named in its REST reference. The Google Workspace developer Terms of Service page applies the Google APIs Terms of Service to Google Workspace APIs and lists no additional terms for this API.

rootUrl of the Google Tasks API in its Discovery Service document, and the service endpoint named in its REST reference. The Google Workspace developer Terms of Service page applies the Google APIs Terms of Service to Google Workspace APIs and lists no additional terms for this API.

rootUrl of the People API in its Discovery Service document, and the service endpoint named in its REST reference. The People API pages link the Google API Services User Data Policy as their terms, which states that it and the Google APIs Terms of Service govern the use of Google API Services; no additional terms for the People API were found.
Token and revocation endpoints in Google's OAuth 2.0 for web server applications guide.
Authorization endpoint (https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth) in the same guide; the user's browser is sent here.

jurisdictions.note: The Google APIs Terms of Service define "Google" as Google LLC, 1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, California, unless additional terms for a given API say otherwise, and select the laws of California. This records the contracting party; none of the pages checked states where requests to these endpoints are processed.

The Google APIs Terms of Service apply the Google Controller-Controller Data Protection Terms to the extent data protection law requires. Section 5.3 of those terms (version 11) states that Controller SCCs are not required for European Controller Personal Data transferred to Google, because the address of Google Ireland Limited, the applicable Google End Controller, is in an Adequate Country.

euRegion.notes: Each API in the Discovery Service lists a single rootUrl for these endpoints, and the OAuth 2.0 guide names one authorization and one token endpoint. No region an API caller can select was found for them. Data residency settings on the products behind them, such as Google Workspace data regions, belong to the account administrator and are not visible from the calling code.

notes: This entry covers Google endpoints and client libraries shared by many Google APIs, so a finding against it names Google but not which API. Its legal facts are those of the Google APIs Terms of Service, under which Google and the API caller are independent controllers; no processor terms under GDPR Art 28 were found for that relationship, which is why dpa is recorded as unavailable. Those terms yield to additional terms for a given API: Identity Toolkit, one of the APIs served from www.googleapis.com, is offered as part of Google Cloud Identity Platform and Firebase Authentication, whose own terms apply instead. Gmail's dedicated endpoint gmail.googleapis.com and package @googleapis/gmail stay with the google-gmail-api entry, which carries the Gmail-specific facts. The client libraries listed here also authenticate Google Cloud services, so a dependency on them shows that Google is called, not under which terms. Host list derivation (2026-11-02): each API's discoveryRestUrl was taken from the Discovery Service directory and its discovery document read for rootUrl. Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms, People and Tasks each have a dedicated rootUrl, matching the service endpoint in their REST reference, and are listed as exact hosts. Drive (v2 and v3) and Calendar v3 have rootUrl https://www.googleapis.com/, which is already listed; drive.googleapis.com and calendar-json.googleapis.com were not added, because no rootUrl or service endpoint names them (calendar-json.googleapis.com serves only Calendar's discovery document). The mTLS variants (for example docs.mtls.googleapis.com) were not added. The Google Workspace developer Terms of Service page applies the Google APIs Terms of Service to Google Workspace APIs and lists additional terms only for Cloud Identity, Apps Script, the Drive API (Drive API Policies), the Admin SDK and the Marketplace, none of which covers the hosts added here. Google Cloud service endpoints under googleapis.com, such as storage.googleapis.com, and the YouTube APIs are deliberately outside this entry; the terms they are offered under were not reviewed for it, so they are left unmatched rather than given these facts.
